svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 60 x 3 mm strip about 430 mm long; deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bend 90 degrees twice: an upright 335 mm tall, a top leg 49.5 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: long reaching back, and a tab 43 mm long turned down.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tab: two 4.5 mm holes, 20 mm apart, for M4 screws through the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Catch block 50 x 8 x 8 mm: rivet or screw it to the front face of

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the upright, its underside 318 mm above the upright's bottom end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It sits 1 mm behind the pack's latch pawl and just above it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the bottom end stands 10 mm down in the cradle's catch slot;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the tab is screwed to the liner back wall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: with a pack dummy in the cradle the pawl passes under the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: catch with the 1 mm gap, and the upright is vertical.
